description: List and search Scheduled Maintenance Events from OneUptime with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting. Returns an array of Scheduled Maintenance Event objects plus the total matching count.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 10, Maximum: 100.

query.description: Filter criteria for Scheduled Maintenance Events. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.
